headline: Kuura Strand Erupts as Gutter Falls Fully Colonial
war_summary: Kuura Strand has burst into flame since our last edition, its casualty ledger swelling from single figures to better than three hundred and seventy Colonial and two hundred and eighteen Warden losses in two hours as flags turned at Martti, leaving one Colonial toehold among five Warden posts. Olavis Wake, the front we led with before, has cooled markedly — from thousand-loss hours to a few hundred — though Iltaku and Kulkue still saw movement as this report closed. Gutter's map has been settled: after ninety-one changes on the day, the Warden foothold is swept away and all seven posts now fly Colonial colors, the past two hours grown still. Weathered Expanse grinds on with fifty-one flag events on the day, Spirit Watch the busiest ground and its two ruined posts unrebuilt. Marban Hollow has come back to life, Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall again the busiest ground. The Nevish Line, costly at day's peak, has gone quiet. This is the war's 655th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
